output_example.deprecated_note: The verdict, stop and target fields are deprecated compatibility fields, never advice. verdict is descriptive (wall_in_band, no_wall_in_band or thin_data) and reads the same wall set as the descriptive flags liq_distance_pct, wall_within_1pct and crowd_aligned, which replace it. stop_suggestion and target_suggestion mirror the deprecated plan and render on no customer surface.
output_example.flags_basis: liq_distance_pct: the closest wall's distance from price in percent, from one per-side wall set (the near cell, the band wall, or the labeled ladder fallback). wall_within_1pct: that same distance is under one percent. crowd_aligned: the funding side the crowd pays on agrees with the pull direction; null without a funding read. Descriptive, never a recommendation.

output_example.verdict_rule: verdict reads the same wall set as flags: wall_in_band when the nearest wall on either side is under 1 percent from price (the emitted liq_distance_pct), no_wall_in_band when walls exist but none is that close, thin_data when there is no price or no wall data. verdict_long and verdict_short apply the same test to that side's losing-side wall only (below for a long, above for a short) and add the liquidation distance of a hypothetical entry at the current price and assumed_leverage, or of your position when you send one. Descriptive, never a recommendation: proceed, reduce and skip are no longer emitted.

_meta.verdict_compatibility_contract: The deprecated compatibility field verdict is wall_in_band, no_wall_in_band or thin_data, never null; proceed, reduce and skip are no longer emitted (contract change, SDK 0.4.1 docs). wall_in_band means the nearest wall on either side is under 1 percent from price, the same distance as flags.liq_distance_pct and the same test as flags.wall_within_1pct; thin_data means no price or no wall data. verdict_long and verdict_short apply that test to the losing-side wall (below for a long, above for a short) at the current price and assumed_leverage, or for your position. confidence is null with confidence_basis unscored until the public ledger scores verdicts. Compatibility metadata includes verdict_side, verdict_long, verdict_short, verdict_other, bias and confidence.
